senses.zh_definition: 盖恩斯：英语姓氏，可见于 Ernest J. Gaines 等人名；单凭此输入无法确定具体人物。
senses.en_definition: Gaines, a surname borne by people including the American writer Ernest J. Gaines.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga dalam nama orang, misalnya penulis Amerika Syarikat Ernest J. Gaines; orang yang dimaksudkan bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 按专有名词解释，规范写法为 Gaines。输入没有 DBP 释义，也没有能确定所指的上下文，故不认定其为已核实的马来语普通词或标为 official。这里的马来文释义是说明性编写。姓氏实例依据：[路易斯安那大学盖恩斯中心](https://louisiana.edu/ernestgaines/author)。以下为自然的人名组合，不是已验证的高频固定搭配。

etymology.historical_story: A documented cultural bearer of this surname is Ernest J. Gaines, whose fiction explores race, community, and human dignity in Louisiana. His name may therefore appear unchanged in Malay literary discussion. This cultural example does not establish the surname's historical derivation or identify the person intended by the isolated input. [University biography](https://louisiana.edu/ernestgaines/author).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Gaines 常读作 /ɡeɪnz/，可借英语 gains 的同音帮助记住发音；它在这里是姓氏，不能译成“收益”。
